# `promiseRaceInEffect`

Warns when Promise.race or Promise.any races a list of promises inside Effect code, leaving the losing promises running

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Effect-native |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377212`, `TS377213` |
| Language Service name | `promiseRaceInEffect` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/promise-race-in-effect` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const mirrors: ReadonlyArray<string>
declare const download: (url: string) => Promise<Uint8Array>

export const preview = Effect.tryPromise(() => Promise.any(mirrors.map((url) => download(url))))
/**
                                               ^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(promise-race-in-effect): This Effect code races promises with `Promise.any`; the losing promises keep running and are not interrupted. Use `Effect.raceAll` over Effect values instead.
*/
```
